description: Rex controlled the operating, seminar and marketing entities.
Compensation depended mainly on recruitment, starter packages and downline volume rather than external retail.
Quincy knowingly operated the concentrated commission and payout system.
Celeste knowingly directed recruitment pressure, rank deadlines and testimonial messaging.
Bruno knowingly recruited through stage events and downline incentives.
Genuine products and real external sales existed, especially Rosie’s retail-led business.
Tilly, Marco and Daisy recruited others while remaining net-loss victims rather than core operators.
Testimonials emphasized gross success and omitted participant costs and recruitment dependence.
